7:31.text: O Children of Adam! Take your adornment
the Ka‘bah, and eat and drink but waste not by extravagance, certainly He

7:32.text: : "Who has forbidden the adornment with clothes given by Allâh, which He has produced for His slaves, and At-Taiyyibât
of food?" Say: "They are, in the life of this world, for those who believe,
in detail for people who have knowledge.

7:33.text: the things that my Lord has indeed forbidden are Al-Fawâhish
(great evil sins and every kind of unlawful sexual intercourse)
whether committed openly or secretly, sins
with Allâh for which He has given no authority, and saying things about Allâh of which you have no knowledge."

7:34.text: And every nation has its appointed term; when their term comes, neither can they delay it nor can they advance it an hour

7:35.text: O Children of Adam! If there come to you Messengers from amongst you, reciting to you My Verses, then whosoever becomes pious and righteous, on them shall be no fear nor shall they grieve.

7:36.text: But those who reject Our Ayât
and treat them with arrogance, they are the dwellers of the
Fire, they will abide therein forever.

7:37.text: Who is more unjust than one who invents a lie against Allâh or rejects His Ayât
(good things of this worldly life and their period of stay therein)
will reach them from the Book
(the angel of death and his assistants)
come to them to take their souls, they

will say: "Where are those whom you used to invoke and worship besides Allâh," they will reply, "They have vanished and deserted us." And they will bear witness against themselves, that they were disbelievers.
